messages.subject: Project Drake — SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Please find attached the first draft of the share purchase agreement for Project Drake. Key points to flag: warranty cap at 30% of equity consideration; 24-month general claims limit; de minimis £25k and basket £224k; full tax covenant at Schedule 5; earn-out mechanics at Schedule 6; and a specific environmental indemnity at clause 9.4 capped at £250k for the Hamble contamination.

We look forward to your mark-up.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
